books.title: Covered Copy
books.author: mkept
pages: Recovered from the public entrance. This is a copy, not an oracle. The original survey stayed above because builders needed it in daylight.
Mouth axis: forward with the old drainage cut. Do not use the village well. The well goes somewhere else.
If you can read service 1842, you have enough of my trail to use the lower register. —m

books.title: Entry Register
books.author: Civic Office
pages: SHELTER ENTRY / use one line per household. Mark tools separately. Do not count visitors as stores.
Later hand: copy damaged during the third move. Household totals verified against ration issue before transfer below.
Modern pencil: the key is under the survey model. Put it back when the gate takes the receipt. —mkept

books.title: Three Survey Layers
books.author: Orin
pages: Layer A: rough shelter cuts. Shallow heat trench. No school wall. Intake follows the old clay seam.
Layer B: civic ring. Market east. School west. Cistern moved behind the sound wall.
Layer C: pressure works and Deep Line. New stone is darker because it came from below the safe seam.
Do not order these by how clean the copies look. Order them by what had to exist first.

books.title: Heat Issue 12
books.author: Vaun
pages: Population certified: 87. Standard heat allotment: two baskets per resident per cold cycle.
Issued to public rooms: 174 baskets. Private braziers are charged to their room, never to the population line.
If the sum differs, check whether someone has moved a private room into the public column.

books.title: Tuesday Copybook
books.author: Lower School
pages: Tuesday: measure bean rows. Trade two chalk ends for one clean slate. Return lamp glass after sums.
Sella drew the market roof too tall again. It leaks in the drawing exactly where it leaks in the room.
Home task: ask why our grandmothers chose the warm stone instead of the east road. Write an answer without using the word afraid.

books.title: Vent Stave
books.author: Lamp Office
pages: Clerk marks follow the teaching strip beside the model. One mark is one ordinary letter; there are no silent runes.
The line is an evacuation instruction, not a prayer.

books.title: Founding Minutes
books.author: Civic Office
pages: East road rejected: exposed for eleven miles and no running water after the quarry bend.
Shallow shelter rejected: fuel loss exceeds stores before the next harvest estimate.
Deep civic works approved for three reasons only: stable heat, stable water, and cover from the long weather.
The decision was not madness. Do not turn frightened arithmetic into prophecy.

books.title: Filter Issue Ledger
books.author: Vaun
pages: FILTER CLOTH / received 12 bolts / cistern receipt 7 / balance expected 5.
CHARCOAL / received 16 sacks / cistern receipt 10 / balance expected 6.
Do not call a missing balance spoilage until the return chest and favored-room docket have both been checked.

books.title: Returned Goods
books.author: Stores Office
pages: Blue stitch: cistern. Red stitch: public heat. Brass staple: private heat. Black wax: condemned.
Return like with like. A clean item in the wrong account is still a false account.
Five cloth tags and six charcoal seals carry the brass staple for Hearth Row Three.

books.title: Vaun Affidavit
books.author: Vaun
pages: I reconciled the stores after Nessa was removed. The missing material was issued with authority. That does not make the issue honest.
I kept a second column because the first was being made clean around me. I did not place that column before the hearing.
Shift the line below backward by the missing cloth balance: HMJHP MJFWYM YMWJJ FLFNSXY UZRU WJHJNUY.
Seal note: retain unopened until the recovered archive supplies the affidavit index.

books.title: Civic Manual E1
books.author: Mara
pages: Cistern approach: west stair, two low markers, east gallery, three brass posts.
Edition note: written before the sound wall. Do not use after wall completion.

books.title: Civic Manual E2
books.author: Mara
pages: Cistern approach: east stair, one high marker, west gallery, two iron posts.
Margin: temporary diversion during school-wall work. Strike when wall reopens.

books.title: Civic Manual E3
books.author: Mara
pages: Cistern approach: west stair, two low markers, east gallery, three brass posts.
Verified after the sound wall. This is the last edition bearing both route and load checks.

books.title: Civic Manual E4
books.author: Civic Copy Room
pages: Cistern approach: east stair, direct gallery, white post. Avoid public route during inquiry.
No editor signature. Paper batch belongs to the heat office.

books.title: Mara Margin Index
books.author: Mara
pages: Use the verified edition. Page marks 1 / 2 / 4 / 4 / 6 point to the route words in the five comparison slips.
The extraction describes movement, not a sentence: WEST TWO / LOW ONE / EAST THREE.
Walk only the marked floor. If the room accepts a wrong route, the route listener is broken.

books.title: Mara Affidavit
books.author: Mara
pages: I made the temporary route readable. Then I let a temporary order become the clean edition.
A manual can save a room. It can also make an unsafe room look official enough to enter.
The recovered archive will tell you which revision mark is a letter. Until then, keep every margin.

books.title: Shore Copybook
books.author: Sella
pages: The damp transferred my last line backward. I left it because the mistake points the right way.
DZGVI PVVKH GSV YZXP LU GSV KZTV
Match the reversed shoreline to the cistern intake. The school roof belongs north of the long reed bed.

books.title: Sample Note
books.author: Sella
pages: Intake sample taken behind the folded reeds, not at the public landing. Clear water above, grey sediment below.
Nessa labeled both layers. The hearing displayed only the top vial.
I made a joke in the school copy because I thought adults corrected mistakes when shown. I was young, not stupid.

books.title: Sella Affidavit
books.author: Sella
pages: The map was turned to fit the ruling. Water does not care which edge of a page an office calls north.
I kept the transfer copy. Read its back when the archive gives you the index.
If this sounds like a riddle, blame the people who made plain evidence unsafe to keep plainly.

books.title: Third Bay Tolerances
books.author: Orin
pages: Read low marks at inspection height. Standing eye makes the center cuts appear level when they are not.
Acceptable lateral shift: one finger. Measured after heat-shaft work: three fingers and increasing.
OLD NZIPH KLRMG MLIGS GSVM VZHG

books.title: Signed Safe
books.author: Orin
pages: Certificate: third bay may remain open if heat load is reduced and the east brace is installed before next cycle.
Private note: load was not reduced. Brace arrived cut short. I signed because closure would strand the lower rooms.
The signature is mine. So is the cowardice around it.

books.title: Orin Affidavit
books.author: Orin
pages: The fracture existed before Iss's final cut. His cut loaded it. Both statements belong in the same account.
I sealed from inside because the outer lever had already gone. Do not turn that into sacrifice. It was the only reachable work.
Keep the bearing. The archive index reads posture before ink.

books.title: Black Watch Rota
books.author: Brann
pages: Bell 7: Toma / Leth. Bell 8: Leth / Brann. Bell 9: Brann / empty relief line.
Audio failed twice that week. The wall lamps repeat the toll in long and short states. Read both.
Rail copy: PNWEYRARIEIHMTHUINTPO. Three rails. No spaces were filed.

books.title: Time Correction
books.author: Brann
pages: The empty relief line was later filled with Nessa's name. She had already been removed from duty.
The official alarm is one bell late. Pair bell nine with the empty hour to recover the substitution.
I corrected the copy after people died. That is not the same as correcting the watch.

books.title: Brann Affidavit
books.author: Brann
pages: The real first alarm was at bell eight. The Record accepted bell nine because bell nine had two names on its clean copy.
I know the difference between staying awake and witnessing. One is a body. The other is an honest second account.
The archive index uses the empty hour.

books.title: A Warmer Account
books.author: Iss
pages: Key: REEDS. I chose it because the first living reeds were proof, not metaphor.
KLI VMIJEFW SVIDLYIW EMK XLH LYMVG TRC GDFESX
I wanted an argument strong enough to open a door. I made it stronger than the stone.

books.title: Keepsake Receipt
books.author: Heat Office
pages: Item: reed knot in sealed glass. Claimed source: beyond Deep Line. Condition: living green at recovery.
Filed condition: dry brown sample. The physical item retains the original recovery tag.
Inspect the item, not only this copy. A clean page cannot change persistent material evidence.

books.title: Iss Affidavit
books.author: Iss
pages: Mercy was the word I used when I signed Averyn out of the roster. A blank seemed kinder than public blame.
Every first line below is arranged to offer the wrong initial. Read the correction marks instead.
My route proved the surface. It did not prove the third bay could bear me. Both truths survive me.

books.title: Pump Complaints
books.author: Nessa Vale
pages: Cycle 3: grey sediment at reed intake after pressure drop. Top draw clear. Lower draw metallic.
Cycle 4: replacement cloth sheds when wet. Requested stores comparison and second witness.
Cycle 5: told to keep public tap open. Filed two samples. Hearing displayed one.

books.title: Sample Register
books.author: Cistern Office
pages: White seal: upper draw. Grey seal: lower draw. Reed cord: intake A. Clay cord: intake B.
Sort by intake first, then cycle. Never combine top and lower draw because the top clears before sediment settles.
Missing from hearing inventory: A-lower cycles 3 and 4.

books.title: Flush Configuration
books.author: Nessa Vale
pages: For an intake-A sediment test: A OPEN / B CLOSED / MAIN FILTER OPEN / REED BYPASS CLOSED / WASHOUT OPEN.
Frames point along flow when open and across flow when closed. This is a static model; no timing is required.
If the model consumes a key or changes randomly, stop and repair it.

books.title: Relief Roster
books.author: Brann
pages: Nessa: cycles 1–4, removed before cycle 5. Toma Rill: cycle 5 relief. Brann: cycle 5 witness.
Clean copy lists Nessa at cycle 5 and omits Toma. Toma's meal chit and Brann's stair mark agree.
Question for filing: who actually replaced Nessa at cycle 5?

books.title: Filter Invoice 44
books.author: East Market Cooperative
pages: Genuine bolts carry blue thread through both selvages. Delivered bolts carry blue surface dye and an unmarked inner weave.
Grid marks on crates read: 2-1 / 1-1 / 3-1 / 4-3 / 1-5. Use the market stall grid, row then column (I and J share one stall).
The extracted word identifies the invoice class: FALSE. Compare purchase totals before naming a person.

books.title: Cache Reopening Slip
books.author: Civic Office
pages: Service cache 7-W may be reopened only from the folded-reeds route. Three exhibits are required: genuine filter, original purchase receipt, sealed Drafts A/B.
Exhibit slots are marked FILTER / RECEIPT / DRAFTS. A claim is not a filing: one linked finder must handle all three before the cache seal accepts them.
Averyn margin: compare the drafts themselves before deciding whether the worker failed the water or the material failed the worker.

books.title: Eight House Docket
books.author: Averyn
pages: The copied village has eight useful differences. Do not treat four as decoration. Each corrects one line of the Break finding.
Lamp: outage. Cairn: fracture. Coop: birds. Well: pressure. Watch: time. Warm: surface. Threshold: inner seal. Base: copying.
The entrance is the village well. The Hold has no tunnel to this place. Return by the well when the comparison is complete.

books.title: Service Synchronization
books.author: Works Office
pages: Order matters because each restored system supplies the next instrument: filter / lamp / pressure / survey / painted line / service key.
All controls are static and latched. No step depends on redstone timing or random updates.
A lost issued component may be recovered from the completion register. Do not rebuild the district to replace one item.

books.title: mkept Admin Notes
books.author: mkept
pages: Copied the world before touching the lower region. Ash keeps video. Rook keeps geometry. Wren keeps saying he remembers routes nobody showed him.
Copperline account is real and ancient. Service 1842 still answers through the community archive if the direct listing vanishes.
If we fail: do not solve our notes as six answers. There are four of us and one of us is leaking.

books.title: Ash Field Notebook
books.author: Ash
pages: Rook said use ROOK as the column order because nobody could forget who moved the wall. Fair. I still wrote it on the barrel lid.
Cipher strip: OCUYTKRVCNMIOITHCTMTSCAIAUONPTECE. Fill four columns; read duplicate O columns left to right.
Camera joke for future me: if a single frame says ASH and the manifest says 13, that is not subtle. It is supposed to survive panic.

books.title: Rook Route Changes
books.author: Rook
pages: Blocked east throat after the room opened before we reached its switch. Only Wren knew the next route sketch.
Changed bridge plan in private. Watcher used the revised span the same night. Ash did not have it. mkept was offline.
Wren says walls repeat. Walls do not repeat a revision that existed in one conversation.

books.title: Witness Spool Index
books.author: automatic transcript
pages: Channel W / packet 14: mkept login route. Packet 19: Ash camera cache. Packet 23: Rook bridge revision.
Packet 28: fear responses by name. Source voice matches Wren at the camp recorder.
The index proves transmission. It does not decide whether terror excuses it. That judgment is not a checksum.

books.title: Averyn's Finding
books.author: Averyn
pages: Finding: Nessa Vale followed sample procedure. Material failure preceded her removal. The displayed sample was not the filed pair.
Confidence: high. Sources: lower-draw vials, genuine filter remnant, purchase receipt, shift meal chit, two disciplinary drafts.
If the Record rejects a finding because its roster rejects the analyst, the Record is measuring obedience, not truth.

books.title: Release Protocol
books.author: Averyn
pages: Return the six affidavits. They are testimony, not occupants. Leave my Record slot empty.
Install Cistern Seal, System Key, and Protocol Bridge. The chamber verifies durable node state; duplicates do not strengthen it.
Choose what happens to my name outside this system. Do not choose whether I remain inside. I do not consent to remain.
When everyone present has operated the floor, arm the close. The server saves before the lights begin.

books.title: A Name Outside
books.author: Averyn
pages: AVERYN. Registrar. Cistern analyst. Returning rescuer. No longer an interface of the Record.
You kept the name without keeping the person. That is the difference.
The gates remain open for witnesses. The machinery is quiet.

books.title: The Chosen Blank
pages: The final filing was destroyed at the subject's request. The evidence remains. The slot does not own a person.
You did not owe me a name. You gave me an end. That was enough.
The gates remain open for witnesses. The machinery is quiet.
